translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from source extraction and all twenty PDF page images. No prior English translation or translation service used. Edition glossary and primary dictionaries consulted; interpretation and uncertainties recorded per source ID. No independent specialist review.

notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l001: Sentence continues Manas’s resolve at1348:40–42, including the preceding cotton-belt/broad-boots formula.
notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l007: Buttered-wheat face and dusk-mist eyes on8 are preserved color/appearance comparisons; no inferred medical condition.
notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l010: Steel understood as blade held along with the lance. No exact second weapon subtype supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l018: Мант берип provisionally dodging in the fox-like feint; exact gait nuance is qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l022: Regained flesh and the horse-directed curse are retained despite the preceding praise. Not a claim of actual slaughter.
notes.manas-2010:p1349:b001:l025: Explicit absence of wings retained even though тулпар elsewhere receives winged-steed praise; no silent harmonization.
notes.manas-2010:p1350:b001:l002: Since tiny childhood retains the unmarked relational clause. The precise person with whom he was together is not supplied; river expertise is assigned explicitly to Almambet on4.
notes.manas-2010:p1350:b001:l006: Forty fathoms preserves the source’s armspan measure without a modern metric conversion.
notes.manas-2010:p1350:b001:l013: Rope pressed against the body is the printed rescue action; no unprinted knot or rigging inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p1350:b001:l022: Taking the stirrup is distinct from Bakay’s rope rescue and is not omitted as redundant.
notes.manas-2010:p1350:b001:l031: Туйгун prized pale goshawk and канкор lord of battles follow established lexicon, not tyrant by default.
notes.manas-2010:p1351:b001:l008: Half surviving retained beside many drowned and tenfold numerical advantage on13–14; no troop-count recalculation.
notes.manas-2010:p1351:b001:l028: Madykan’s single eye retained as explicit supernatural anatomy, distinct from the bull’s single horn1352:26.
notes.manas-2010:p1351:b001:l036: Weather-changing magic is explicit in жайлап and the summer-to-winter reversal. No scientific mechanism supplied.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l006: Visible Кымын interpreted contextually as the recurrent чымын жан frail-life formula; same page1352:22 Чымын жанга supplies the exact noun phrase. Raw not changed; phonetic/textual variation remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l010: Self-offering language is grateful hyperbole addressed to Almambet, not a claim that the army actually sacrificed itself here.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l014: Visible муздан калган river left in ice retained beside the explicitly frozen crossing1351:38. Precise grammar is unusual; no claim of ice having melted.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l024: Wearing an iron shield and its shot-proof quality are the epic’s explicit description; not silently changed to a breastplate.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l026: Single horn belongs contextually to the following mountain-sized gray bull; no rhinoceros substituted.
notes.manas-2010:p1352:b001:l040: Both Koshoy and Muzburchak are struck together, then captured on1353:1–2; no death asserted here.
notes.manas-2010:p1353:b001:l006: Maaniker and Kögala remain the printed mounts of the unhorsed Bokmurun/Kökchö, despite Kögala’s recurrent association with Chubak elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p1353:b001:l021: Extraction Аман алын is visibly Аман алып in the image, corroborated same-page1353:14; carried away translates this minor consonant error without changing raw.
notes.manas-2010:p1353:b001:l038: One forefather plus children of kinsmen at39 expresses shared ancestry; not literal same father in conflict with the stated patronymics.
notes.manas-2010:p1354:b001:l011: Reviving deadened lives is the rescue formula after captivity; not an independent resurrection event.
notes.manas-2010:p1354:b001:l012: Telkyzyl and Kabylan are named horses here; Kabylan not translated as a separate leopard.
notes.manas-2010:p1354:b001:l026: Reached our roots preserves түпкө жет- total ruin image; the exact compressed temporal connection to the condition remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1354:b001:l031: Visible өлбөгөн not dead retained as still surviving, despite the mortal combat. No negative removed.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l001: Аты уйкаш exact Yudakhin expression means namesake/matching or rhyming names https://el-sozduk.kg/уйкаш/. Literal matching names retained even though Almambet and Syrgak do not transparently rhyme. No unsupported replacement with matched horses; this formula’s application remains unresolved at the nuance level.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l003: Ringing interpreted as the sound of blows on Madykan’s defenses, while he remains indifferent; not vocal singing.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l005: Ankle/lower-leg comparison preserves the contempt image, not an invented physical height measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l016: Six thousand Chinese and countless governors retained separately. Калдай governor, not a generic giant.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l030: Heads as buckets of blood preserves the printed battlefield hyperbole.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l041: Karanar preserved as the camel designation with black-camel gloss; preceding Zhelmaian remains separately stated, without asserting two different animals.
notes.manas-2010:p1355:b001:l042: Окто halter corresponds to нокто with initial-n loss documented in edition preface15; not ammunition on the camel’s head.
notes.manas-2010:p1356:b001:l005: Күлазык travel provisions from Kanykey, established lexicon. No recipe or assumed ingredients introduced.
notes.manas-2010:p1356:b001:l027: Темир алп and Чоюн алп rendered Iron Giant and Cast-Iron Giant, transparent epic designations; not alloy measurements or modern military machines.
notes.manas-2010:p1356:b001:l037: Parenthetical praise on37–40 remains translated verse, with lake comparison aligned to37 and generosity to38.
notes.manas-2010:p1357:b001:l019: Кул rendered wretch in Kongurbay’s contemptuous epithet, not an assertion of legal enslavement.
notes.manas-2010:p1357:b001:l034: Flood survival and Alexander’s absent footprints on36 are narrator’s epic historical claims, not independently verified history. Distinct from the recent river flood1351.
notes.manas-2010:p1357:b001:l039: Increasing with deaths retains the epic’s impossible numerical image; not normalized to ordinary reinforcements.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l012: Ылама lama title, with great Zholoy immediately following; whether these are fully separate referents is not forcibly resolved.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l017: Explicit tassel-less lance retained despite other descriptions of Almambet’s tasseled weapon.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l021: Ырапыс ribbed cloth, established dictionary/lexicon rep material; no guessed leather or armor.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l024: Half a mountain retains теңиндей numerical image; not merely mountain-sized.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l037: Genitive-shaped saintly old man phrase read appositionally as Bakay’s epithet, not an invented father named Saint.
notes.manas-2010:p1358:b001:l039: Hour for death retained without declaring Bakay dead; next three lines introduce Syrgak.
notes.manas-2010:p1359:b001:l019: Кан interpreted khan in parallel with эр hero on20, not automatically blood from the surrounding battle description; context remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1359:b001:l031: Joining, breaking apart and opening seams are formation/body-overlap images whose precise referent is compressed; all actions remain separately translated.
notes.manas-2010:p1360:b001:l028: Chinese champion is contextually trying to remount fallen Börüköz; Bakay is the decapitating actor on30, followed by explicit report of Börüköz’s death31. Subject shift remains qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1360:b001:l042: Broken wing is Azhybay’s loss-of-mount image continuing1361:1–2, not a literal winged human.
notes.manas-2010:p1361:b001:l006: Таптап training/preparing interpreted with captured Kartküröng as the object; whether the boast also urges soldiers remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1361:b001:l009: Беренжи saddle-pad, exact edition glossary1835:b001:l007–009: felt or hairy hide fitted over the saddle. Not bronze armor or a Muslim veil.
notes.manas-2010:p1361:b001:l011: Калканчы protective cover/shelter, 1969/2015 explanatory dictionaries https://el-sozduk.kg/калканчы/. Here a covering put on in horse equipment context; exact construction and whether for mount or rider remain qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1361:b001:l019: Чот small transverse-bladed hatchet, Yudakhin cited in https://el-sozduk.kg/КЕРКИ/; distinct from келте short musket. Not abacus in this weapon context.
notes.manas-2010:p1361:b001:l029: No elbow-rest and no momentary sleep on30 retain the repeated vigil formula, despite Syrgak’s earlier sleeping episode in a different passage.
notes.manas-2010:p1362:b001:l002: Kalkaman’s black horse is explicitly Manas’s spare mount for dismounted companions; two possessive designations retained without invented ownership transfer.
notes.manas-2010:p1362:b001:l022: Many champions rescuing Zholoy is the contextual subject before Chubak’s arrival; not Chubak rescuing and immediately killing him.
notes.manas-2010:p1362:b001:l027: Zholoy’s decapitation retained as expressly narrated here; no reconciliation to other versions or earlier apparent deaths.
notes.manas-2010:p1362:b001:l038: Seven thrown down by Almambet and seven beheaded by Syrgak on1363:2–4 retained as distinct actions.
notes.manas-2010:p1362:b001:l041: Black felt hat’s brim is Syrgak’s recurrent affectionate epithet, not an introduced Karakalpak identity.
notes.manas-2010:p1363:b001:l007: Misty corners and pointed edges preserve the indistinct terrain description, repeated at1365:31–32. Exact shape/structure remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1363:b001:l026: Time to die is ominous narration, not a statement that all four named heroes have already died.
notes.manas-2010:p1363:b001:l042: Khan Baltay retained as printed beside the usual Akbaltay patronymic; no separate invented father.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l004: Visible Orokbash retained beside preceding Orokkyr, likely naming variation but not silently harmonized.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l010: Agayar’s camel-lifting epithet retained; not asserted that he lifts a camel during this rescue.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l012: Visible чок embers retained in the battle image; not silently changed to чог/кол host.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l028: Жебе point interpreted with the preceding axe and following handle; not a separately fired arrow introduced between these rows.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l031: Visible кыны sheath retained, even though handle would be mechanically smoother after broken weapons.
notes.manas-2010:p1364:b001:l033: Explicit conjectural Саздакты→Саадакты, supported by near-exact same-edition1372:b001:l008 Саадагын сая тартарда and ammunition exhaustion34–35. Yudakhin саадак sense2 bow with gear and саадак тарт- shoot a bow https://el-sozduk.kg/саадак/. Ordinary саздак means marsh and does not fit. Raw unchanged; not manuscript-collated.
notes.manas-2010:p1365:b001:l014: Cannot die is Kongurbay’s astonished assessment of living Syrgak, not an independent immortality assertion.
notes.manas-2010:p1365:b001:l026: Stones over the trapped victim is only Kongurbay’s proposed act; no actual stoning invented.
notes.manas-2010:p1365:b001:l035: Printed чек boundary/limit rendered barrier in the cliff-high enclosing construction. No silent change to чеп fortress; exact architecture unverified.
notes.manas-2010:p1366:b001:l006: Fleeing in earnest retained beside repeated pretend-flight language; physical speed and deceptive purpose can coexist without deleting either clause.
notes.manas-2010:p1366:b001:l007: Илегер scheming/crafty, exact explanatory dictionary senseII https://el-sozduk.kg/илегер/, rather than physician senseI.
notes.manas-2010:p1366:b001:l009: Two eyes becoming four retains the intense watching/desire idiom, not physical transformation.
notes.manas-2010:p1366:b001:l032: Slaughter like a fly preserves the warning’s unusual image; not silently changed to sheep or another sacrificial animal.
notes.manas-2010:p1367:b001:l011: Оңкоюп provisionally surging forward in the attack; exact body posture remains uncertain.
notes.manas-2010:p1367:b001:l017: Daughter-seller retains the conventional source curse, not an independent claim about Koyonboz’s family conduct.
notes.manas-2010:p1367:b001:l026: Parenthesized timing clause remains verse, not apparatus.
notes.manas-2010:p1368:b001:l006: Дүпө-дүпкө repeated pounding/blows interpreted in the surrounding repeated lance strikes; exact sound nuance qualified.
notes.manas-2010:p1368:b001:l027: Leaving/passing the great encirclement retains printed курчоо; not silently changed to кырк чоро despite the neighboring companions.
notes.manas-2010:p1368:b001:l041: Кара көк human epithet fearless, exact Yudakhin көкIII https://el-sozduk.kg/көк/, established lexicon; not a blue/black color.
notes.manas-2010:p1368:b001:l042: Stirrup-to-stirrup conjunction continues Almambet/Chubak’s attack into1369; no added completion at batch boundary.
